name: Incident — IT Service Outage (4 Hours)
description: A basic template for managing a short IT service outage — server down, application failure, or network disruption. Covers detection, diagnosis, fix, verification, and communication. Suitable as a starting point for any technical service disruption.

groups.name: On-Call Engineer
groups.description: First responder — diagnoses and fixes the issue

groups.name: Affected Users
groups.description: Users or teams impacted by the outage

events.title: OUTAGE DETECTED
events.description: Monitoring alert triggered or user report received. Document affected service and symptoms.

events.title: Initial Assessment
events.description: Engineer triages: what is down, how many users affected, severity classification.

events.title: User Notification — Outage Acknowledged
events.description: Inform affected users that the issue is known and being worked on.

events.title: Root Cause Diagnosis
events.description: Investigate logs, metrics, and recent changes to identify root cause.

events.title: Status Update #1
events.description: Update stakeholders on diagnosis progress and estimated time to fix.

events.title: Fix Applied
events.description: Corrective action applied: restart, patch, configuration change, failover, etc.

events.title: Service Verification
events.description: Confirm service is restored. Check monitoring, run smoke tests, verify user access.

events.title: User Notification — Service Restored
events.description: Inform users that service is back. Note any remaining limitations.

events.title: INCIDENT CLOSED
events.description: Incident formally closed. Schedule post-incident review if warranted.
